Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus; four right angles make a rectangle; both conditions make a square.

Question Choices: Select all shapes that are parallelograms: ~~A | B | C | D | E | F~~
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: B (square),C (rectangle)andE (slanted parallelogram) each have two opposite parallel pairs. A is a triangle; D has nonparallel opposite sides; F has only one parallel pair. Select B,C,E.

Question Choices: Select which shape has all these properties - 1) all four angles are right angles 2) both pairs of opposite sides are parallel 3) adjacent sides have different lengths: ~~Square | Rectangle | Rhombus | Trapezoid~~
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Four right angles give a rectangle. Unequal adjacent sides exclude a square and rhombus.

Question Choices: Select the most specific shape name. This quadrilateral has two pairs of parallel sides. All four sides are the same length, and all angles are right angles. What is the name for this shape?: ~~Dart | Trapezoid | Parallelogram | Kite | Rhombus | Rectangle | Square~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus; four right angles make a rectangle; both conditions make a square.
Solution: Four equal sides and four right angles give the most specific name square. A square is also a rectangle, rhombus and parallelogram, but those broader names do not require both conditions.

Question Choices: Select. A quadrilateral has two pairs of parallel sides and no right angles. What is the best name for this shape?: ~~Square | Rectangle | Trapezoid | Parallelogram~~
Hints: Check opposite parallel sides, right angles and equal side lengths; a shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Two opposite parallel pairs guarantee a parallelogram. No right angles exclude rectangles and squares. Equal side lengths are not given, so rhombus is not guaranteed.
